"About a Girl" is a song by American rock band Nirvana, written by vocalist and guitarist Kurt Cobain.
It is the third song on their debut album, Bleach, released in June 1989.
Frequently described as one of Cobain's strongest and most melodic early compositions, "About a Girl" was written about his then-girlfriend Tracy Marander.
